shortDescription: IDBI Bank SO Online Form 2026-27 for Specialist Officers (about 31 posts). Apply 14–26 July 2026 at idbi.bank.in.
content:
IDBI Bank has invited online applications for Specialist Officers under Advertisement No. 03/2026-27.

Registration: 14 July 2026 to 26 July 2026. Posts include grades in Audit-IS, Infrastructure/Premises, Legal and Security streams.

Cut-off date for age/qualification/experience: 1 July 2026. Apply only through official careers portal.
